symptom.observed: A five-second admitted-generation timeout releases a second provider action while the first lazy SSE action is still active and has not produced terminal success, provider failure, or cancellation.
symptom.expected: An admitted provider action remains the only in-flight action for its generation until an explicit success, failure, terminal commit, or cancellation/drop outcome advances the Rust-owned gate.
raw_evidence: The prior OpenAI Chat and Gemini tests used a fresh second request and became stale after the recovery-only gate correction.
provider_action_gate_contract::admitted_action_requires_explicit_drop_before_replacement_generation proves an owned action remains exclusive beyond five seconds.

forbidden_edges: wall-clock timeout -> inferred provider action cancellation
owner_graph: Direct/Relay callers own only permit lifetime wiring
SSE provider outcome wrappers own terminal/failure/drop observation, not gate policy

hypotheses.cause: The gate treats elapsed five-second wall-clock time as proof that an admitted action disappeared.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The historical V3 gate advanced admitted_generation solely from elapsed time. The current explicit-permit test locks the corrected behavior without treating a fresh request as a recovery waiter.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: Would be false if the second action stayed blocked until the first stream emitted terminal success or was dropped.
hypotheses.verification_action: Run the corrected active-SSE tests and the active-admission-beyond-five-seconds gate contract against current source, then inspect the admitted-generation expiry branch.

hypotheses.cause: Provider success is recorded too late or not recorded for terminal SSE.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The failing tests hold terminal success deliberately while another waiter is active.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: The second action is admitted before success is expected; success timing is correct and the timeout branch is already sufficient to explain the failure.
hypotheses.verification_action: Confirm the tests intentionally delay terminal success beyond the synthetic lease deadline.

hypotheses.cause: A retry/reselect action that fails enters terminal Error05 policy while its own V3ProviderActionPermit is still held by the caller stack, so terminal admission waits forever on the permit that cannot drop until the await returns.
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Isolated terminal provider-error tests hung beyond 60 seconds. Releasing the caller-owned permit before entering provider failure policy made Direct and all Relay terminal tests finish with the expected 1s/5s floors.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: Would be false if terminal Error05 completed while the admitted retry permit remained owned.
hypotheses.verification_action: Run terminal provider-error tests for Direct, Responses Relay, OpenAI Chat Relay, Anthropic Relay, and Gemini Relay with bounded timeouts.
